snippet.title: Starseed Game Boy Color
snippet.description: Starseed is a classic arcade-style shoot 'em up in it's purest form: armed with a limitless supply of bullets - and your wits and cunning - the aim is to destroy the waves of aliens and avoid their barrage of bullets as you perform attack runs on massive dreadnoughts in the depths of space!
